lifecycles._note: Read-only coverage for all 4 quota endpoints. quota is a global (account-scoped) service with no mutating endpoints — all 4 ops are GET. listaccountquota and listquotarequests are directly covered by smoke; showaccountquota is covered by the read_chain (account-quotas list is non-empty). showquotarequest is data-dependent: it requires a real request_id, which only exists when a user has submitted a quota-increase request via the UI — the regression account currently has no quota requests (confirmed: GET /v1/quota-requests returns count:0). This lifecycle exercises list->show for account-quotas (confirms read_chain path), and attempts showquotarequest via soft-capture (silently skipped when list is empty). No mutations, no cleanup. Response envelope confirmed: $.account_quotas[].id (proven 200 in run 2026-06-20).

steps.name: show-quota-request
steps._note: Data-dependent blocker: showquotarequest requires a real request_id from an existing quota-increase request. The regression account has no quota requests (GET /v1/quota-requests -> count:0). No API exists to create quota requests — they are submitted through the SCP UI. This step silently skips when capture_soft yields no request_id.
